text_blocks.snippet: The Omicron variant of COVID-19 generally has a shorter incubation period compared to previous variants, typically around two to four days. This is the average time between exposure to the virus and the onset of symptoms. While it's usually shorter, symptoms can still appear anytime within two to fourteen days after exposure, according to Verywell Health. The incubation period can vary among individuals due to factors like age.
